answer: Within PoA, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest service and making short-lived reputation farming ineffective. EigenTrust factorization, adjusted by reciprocity-weighted transitivity, gives freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality. They lack credible incoming trust, cannot bridge the ledger’s validation graph through a prism of collusion, and therefore cannot pass consensus; no isolated haven changes that constraint.
